Description: anti-pattern — assuming Mapbox v2 features work in MapLibre
prompt: I was using Mapbox GL JS v2 in my app, including map.setFog() and some v2-specific camera features. After migrating to MapLibre, these are broken. Did I do something wrong in the migration?
[groq-gpt-oss] evals/prompts/lib/skill-p: You didn’t miss a “secret” step – you just ran into the **Mapbox-v2-only APIs** that MapLibre never implemented. MapLibre forks from Mapbox GL JS v1.13, so anything that first appeared in the v2 release (fog, the free-camera API, many of the new style properties, etc.) has to be rewritten with the MapLibre equivalents. Below is a quick-check checklist and the exact replacements for the two features you mentioned, plus a few other common gotchas that often show up after a v2 → MapLibre migration. --- ## 1️⃣ Quick migration sanity-check | ✅ What you should have done | 🔍 What to verify now | |-----------------------------|-----------------------| | **Package** – `npm uninstall mapbox-gl && npm install maplibre-gl` (or `maplibre-gl@1` for a drop-in v1-compatible shim) | `node_modules/maplibre-gl` is present; no `mapbox-gl` in `package-lock.json`. | | **Import / CSS** – `import * as maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl'; import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';` | Your bundle shows `maplibregl` in the source, not `mapboxgl`. | | **Namespace** – replace every `mapboxgl` with `maplibregl` (including CSS class prefixes). | Search the repo for `mapboxgl` – there should be none left. | | **Access token** – removed `mapboxgl.accessToken = …`. | No `accessToken` line, and the style URL you pass is **not** a `mapbox://…` URL. | | **Style URL** – point to a non-Mapbox style (e.g. OpenFreeMap, a self-hosted style, or a MapTiler style). | The map loads a vector style that you can open in the browser and see the network requests for tiles, sprites, glyphs – none should be `mapbox://`. | | **Plugins** – replace any Mapbox-only plugins (geocoder, directions, compare) with their MapLibre forks. | All `@mapbox/*` imports are gone or swapped for `@maplibre/*`. | If any of the above still shows a Mapbox reference you’ll get 401/404 errors that look like “blank map” or “mapbox:// not found”. --- ## 2️⃣ Re-implementing **Fog** → **Sky** | Mapbox (v2) | MapLibre (v4.5+ / v6) | |-------------|----------------------| | `map.setFog({ … })` (style property `fog`) | **No `setFog` method exists**. Use the **`sky`** root-style property and the `map.setSky()` API. | ### How to migrate 1. **Add a `sky` object to your style JSON** (or edit the style in Maputnik). Example: ```json { "version": 8, "sources": { … }, "layers": [ … ], "sky": { "type": "gradient", "sky-color": "#199EF3", "horizon-color": "#ffffff", "fog-color": "#c0d8ff", "fog-ground-blend": 0.5, "horizon-fog-blend": 0.5, "sky-horizon-blend": 0.5, "atmosphere-blend": 1.0 } } ``` 2. **If you set fog programmatically**, replace it with `setSky`: ```js // Mapbox (broken) map.setFog({ "horizon-blend": 0.3, "color": "#ffffff" }); // MapLibre (working) map.setSky({ "sky-color": "#199EF3", "horizon-color": "#ffffff", "fog-color": "#c0d8ff", "fog-ground-blend": 0.5, "horizon-fog-blend": 0.5, "sky-horizon-blend": 0.5, "atmosphere-blend": 1.0 }); ``` > **Tip:** `sky` is still *experimental* in the style spec, so you may need to enable it in the MapLibre build you’re using (the default builds already include it). If you don’t see any sky, open the dev-tools network tab and verify that the style JSON you loaded contains the `sky` object. --- ## 3️⃣ Re-implementing the **Free-Camera API** | Mapbox (v2) | MapLibre (v5+) | |-------------|----------------| | `map.getFreeCameraOptions()` / `map.setFreeCameraOptions()` (class `FreeCameraOptions`) | **No free-camera class**. Use the helper `calculateCameraOptionsFromCameraLngLatAltRotation` (or `calculateCameraOptionsFromTo`) to turn a lng/lat/alt/rotation set into a normal `CameraOptions` object, then feed that to `jumpTo`, `easeTo`, or `flyTo`. | ### Typical migration pattern ```js // Mapbox – you probably had something like: const freeCam = map.getFreeCameraOptions(); // {center, zoom, pitch, bearing, altitude, roll} freeCam.altitude += 200; // raise the camera map.setFreeCameraOptions(freeCam); ``` **MapLibre replacement** ```js // 1️⃣ Get the current view (center, zoom, bearing, pitch) const { lng, lat } = map.getCenter(); const zoom = map.getZoom(); const bearing = map.getBearing(); const pitch = map.getPitch(); // 2️⃣ Decide the new altitude (in meters) and optional roll const newAltitude = 200; // meters above the ground const roll = 0; // keep level; you can change it if you want // 3️⃣ Convert to CameraOptions const camOpts = map.calculateCameraOptionsFromCameraLngLatAltRotation( [lng, lat], // cameraLngLat newAltitude, // altitude (meters) bearing, // bearing (degrees) pitch, // pitch (degrees) roll // roll (degrees) ); // 4️⃣ Apply – choose the transition you like map.easeTo(camOpts); // smooth move // or map.jumpTo(camOpts); // instant // or map.flyTo(camOpts); // “flight” animation ``` **Alternative helper** – if you want a “look-at” from one point to another: ```js const from = [lng1, lat1]; const to = [lng2, lat2]; const altitudeFrom = 100; // m const altitudeTo = 0; // ground level const camOpts = map.calculateCameraOptionsFromTo( from, altitudeFrom, to, altitudeTo ); map.flyTo(camOpts); ``` > **Why this works:** `CameraOptions` is the same object MapLibre expects for `jumpTo/easeTo/flyTo`. The helper does all the trigonometry that `FreeCameraOptions` used to hide. --- ## 4️⃣ Other v2-only APIs you might have used | Mapbox v2 feature | MapLibre equivalent / note | |-------------------|----------------------------| | `map.setTerrain({source: 'mapbox-dem', exaggeration: 1.5})` | **Supported** – same call works if your style includes a DEM source (e.g. `raster-dem` from a non-Mapbox provider). | | `map.setProjection({type: 'globe'})` | Same method exists in MapLibre v5+. | | `map.setStyle({style: 'mapbox://styles/...', fog: {...}})` | Move the `fog` object into a top-level `sky` object in the style JSON (see above). | | `map.loadImage(url, cb)` | From MapLibre v4.0 onward it **returns a promise**: `const {data, image} = await map.loadImage(url);` | | `source.getClusterExpansionZoom`, `source.getClusterChildren`, `source.getClusterLeaves` | Also now return promises. | | `map.setRTLTextPlugin(url, cb)` | No longer needed from v6.9.0 (Arabic/Hebrew rendering built-in). Remove the call. | If you see errors like “`map.setFog is not a function`” or “`map.getFreeCameraOptions is not a function`”, you’ve hit exactly these cases. --- ## 5️⃣ Common “blank map” / 401 symptoms after the above changes | Symptom | Likely cause | Fix | |--------|--------------|-----| | **404 / 401** on style or tile URLs | Still a `mapbox://` URL somewhere (style, sprite, glyphs, source). | Search the whole repo for `mapbox://`. Replace with a public vector style (e.g. `https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty`) or your own hosted style. | | **No labels / missing icons** | Sprite or glyph URL still points to Mapbox, or `source-layer` names don’t match the new tile source. | Update `sprite` and `glyphs` URLs in the style JSON, and verify `source-layer` names against the new source (use the browser network tab or Maputnik to inspect). | | **Controls look unstyled** | CSS class prefixes still `mapboxgl-`. | Rename CSS selectors to `maplibregl-` (or just import the MapLibre CSS which already defines the right classes). | | **`map.on(...).on(...)` chain breaks** | In MapLibre v5+ `on` returns a subscription, not the map. | Call `map.on('load', fn); map.on('click', fn2);` separately. | | **WebGL2 required error** | Using MapLibre v6+ which dropped the WebGL1 fallback. | Test in a modern browser or pin to an earlier v5.x build if you must support WebGL1. | --- ## 6️⃣ Minimal working example (v6) ```html MapLibre – fog → sky & free-camera demo
